notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one presses the shaft into the MR128s and opens the socket to slip on the Span Driver's head, as the FITS paragraph of 920-002_DynamicFinger.scad's header gives. The claw is the mesh's part, and DC-900-1 in specs/009 owns which gripper the build takes. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
